s01_title
This is PakVerify: an AI and blockchain based police verification system.
s02_home
It replaces repeated visits to the police station with one secure, online process.
s03_citizen
A citizen signs in, and the dashboard shows the NADRA identity record linked to their CNIC.
s04_apply
They choose the certificate type, enter the purpose and address, and upload their CNIC and photo.
s05_face
Next is live face verification. The citizen looks straight, then turns left and right. ArcFace matches the face with the CNIC photo, and the head-turn check blocks printed photos and screens.
s06_staff
Police staff sign in with a one-time password. The criminal record check has already run, so staff only review the documents.
s07_authority
A senior officer then approves the application from the authority dashboard.
s08_payment
The citizen pays the fee online, and staff confirm the payment.
s09_cert
The certificate is issued with a QR code, and its SHA-256 hash is written to the hash-chain ledger.
s10_verified
At any police desk, an officer can check a certificate. The original PDF matches the stored hash, so it is verified.
s11_tamper
Now someone edits the PDF and changes the holder's name. The hash no longer matches, and PakVerify flags the certificate as tampered.
s12_end
PakVerify. Faster, transparent, and tamper-proof police verification. Thank you.
